Huius præcepti quarti duæ sunt partes. Præceptum, &

main_text.l: ratio præcepti. Præcepti rursus duæ sunt partes: prior
est moralis, vt sanctificetur Sabbatum; id est, vt aliquod
tempus certum tribuatur ministerio Eccl. seu publi-
co Dei cultui. Altera pars est ceremonialis & Temporaria,
scilicet vt tempus illud sit dies septimus, & vt eo seruen-
tur ceremoniæ Leuiticæ. Hanc partem temporari-
am, illam perpetuam esse, intelligitur ex fine præcep-
ti, & causis vtriusq; partis, de quibus postea commo-
dius dicetur. Iam ipsa verba tum præcepti, tum rati-
onis præcepto subiunctæ, paucis explicabimus: qui-
bus cognitis, tanto facilius intelligentur quæ de Sab-
bato deinde dicenda sunt.

page.notes: The woodcut R initial is joined to "ecordare" to read "Recordare". The word "aflentiatur" in the first line is doubtful; I read it as "assentiatur" and marked it. "Prophcta" is probably a printing error and is left as printed. The line "Sabbatum Sanctifices." and the notes "20.&22.26." beside it are in the left margin; "20.&22.26." stands beside the line "one Sabbatum", so it is placed after "Sanctifices." The paragraph ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page and continues on the next page.
